description: On user request, replace arguments of a definitively rejected failed step that has no accepted request ID. Supply expected_arguments from batch_get to prevent stale edits. Revalidates the entire plan, preserves completed work, and pauses; use batch_control resume after repair. Never use for uncertain or accepted jobs.

acknowledge.description: Confirm the user authorized repairing this failed step.
acknowledge.title: Acknowledge

arguments.description: Complete replacement arguments for the failed step.
arguments.title: Arguments

expected_arguments.description: Current step arguments from batch_get, used to detect concurrent edits.
expected_arguments.title: Expected Arguments

step_key.description: Key of the failed step to repair.
step_key.title: Step Key

name: batch_repair
title: Repair failed plan step
